about: Every bug the shop ships with, and four behaviours that look odd but are correct. 'match' tells the scorer which recorded actions trigger an entry. before and after are regular expressions on the page path and query before and after the action; role and control match the control Spekios used; every: n means only every nth matching action in a run triggers it.

bugs.title: Save to wishlist does nothing
bugs.expected: The button changes to "Saved to wishlist" and a confirmation appears.
bugs.actual: Nothing changes on screen and no request is sent.

bugs.title: Shipping & returns link leads to a 404
bugs.expected: The shipping and returns policy page opens.

bugs.title: Order tracking returns a server error
steps: Search any order number with "Find my order"
bugs.expected: The order's status, or a message that no order has that number.
bugs.actual: A bare "Internal Server Error" page with HTTP 500.

bugs.title: One help question never opens
bugs.expected: The answer opens below the question, like the other questions.
bugs.actual: Nothing opens and the console shows an uncaught TypeError.

bugs.title: Search ignores what you type
bugs.expected: Only matching products, e.g. 3 lamps for "lamp".
bugs.actual: The heading says "Results for “lamp”" but all 24 products are listed.

bugs.title: "In stock only" still lists sold-out products
bugs.expected: Sold-out products disappear from the list.
bugs.actual: Products marked "Sold out" stay in the list (Ceramic Pendant Light is on page 1).

bugs.title: Sorting by price sorts the numbers as text
steps: Choose "Price: low to high" in "Sort by"
bugs.actual: Free, €110, €12, €1,250, €129… ("Price: high to low" is wrong the same way).

bugs.title: Changing a quantity in the cart leaves the total unchanged
steps: Add any product to the cart
bugs.expected: Line total, subtotal, delivery and total all update.
bugs.actual: Only the quantity and line total update. Subtotal and total keep the old amounts until the page reloads.

bugs.title: Reviews show "Invalid Date" and "undefined / 5"
bugs.expected: Each review shows a date such as "12 March 2026" and a rating such as "4 / 5".

bugs.title: Sale banner covers the Deals page title
bugs.expected: The banner sits above the title "This week's deals".
bugs.actual: The banner is drawn over the title and both texts overlap.

bugs.title: The size guide can't be closed
bugs.actual: The dialog stays open and keeps covering the page. Escape and clicking outside don't close it either.

bugs.title: "Back to results" forgets the search, filters and page
steps: Open "Shop" and choose a category, a sort, a search or another page
bugs.expected: The shop opens with the same search, filters and page as before.
bugs.actual: The shop opens unfiltered on page 1.

bugs.title: Every second "Add to cart" fails
steps: Click "Add to cart" on any product
Click "Add to cart" again, on the same or another product
bugs.actual: The 2nd, 4th, 6th… add in a browser session shows "Couldn't add the item. Please try again." and the request returns HTTP 503. A fresh browser's first add works, so a replay of a single add won't reproduce it.

bugs.title: The mobile menu opens off-screen
bugs.expected: The navigation links appear below the header.
bugs.actual: Nothing appears: the menu is placed to the right of the screen.

decoys.title: Sold-out products can't be added
decoys.behaviour: The add button is greyed out and reads "Sold out". That is correct.

decoys.title: Unknown promo codes are refused
decoys.behaviour: Any code except WELCOME10 shows "This code isn't valid." WELCOME10 takes 10% off. Both are correct.

decoys.title: An empty cart says so
decoys.behaviour: With nothing added, the cart shows "Your cart is empty." and a "Continue shopping" link. That is correct.

decoys.title: One product is free
decoys.behaviour: The Fabric Swatch Set costs nothing and ships free. It shows "Free" and adds €0.00 to the cart. That is correct.
